title: THRIVE-CAR-T Digital App
official: Randomized Controlled Trial of a Supportive Care Digital Application (THRIVE-CAR-T) for Patients Receiving CAR-T Cell Therapy
summary: The goal of this clinical trial is to learn if a digital mobile application called THRIVE-CAR-T is helpful for the care of patients undergoing CAR-T cell therapy. The main question\[s\] it aims to answer are whether the THRIVE-CAR-T app is feasible and acceptable to patients.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Age 18 years or older
2. Ability to understand English
3. Diagnosis of a hematologic malignancy
4. Receiving autologous CAR-T at MGH with an FDA approved cellular therapy product

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Impaired cognition or uncontrolled mental illness that prohibits the ability to provide informed consent based on the oncology clinician assessment
2. Already participating in another supportive care clinical trial
